lineage.description: County-level population estimates were compiled from three sources (WorldPop, LandScan, and UN data) covering 2008-2015, with additional processing to capture internal migration-driven population changes between 2014-2015. The dataset integrates census data with modeled population distributions to provide sub-national exposure baseline for disaster risk assessment.
